# External Ontology Cache

`owl-time.ttl` in this directory is a vendored copy of the W3C **Time Ontology in OWL** (`http://www.w3.org/2006/time`) used for offline import resolution via `ontology/catalog-v001.xml` in Protégé and ROBOT.

- **IRI**: http://www.w3.org/2006/time
- **Specification**: S. Cox and C. Little, *Time Ontology in OWL*, W3C Recommendation, 2017 (<https://www.w3.org/TR/owl-time/>).
- **License**: Retains its original W3C Document / Software License.
